'''Nick Glaze''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2001 Albany tournament (23 June)]] on 23 June 2001 with [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|TDIGWATT]], according to Hayes Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2537">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-27-if-mike-dalton-can-do-it-so-can-id2537/ if-mike-dalton-can-do-it-so-can-i], DeckTech (Hayes "Hayes" Hunter, 27 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-27-if-mike-dalton-can-do-it-so-can-id2537/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
